messages:
Anne W: quick sync 99we need final RICE estimates and launch gates for the Q3 customer-driven slate. two candidates: Predictive Batching (PB) and Model-tier Routing (MTR). short takes only, plz.

Derek C: can someone paste the current RICE numbers? i only have scribbles from the sync

Anne W: pasting the working numbers (normalized to our scoring):
```
PB: Reach=0.45 Impact=6 Confidence=0.6 Effort=3 => RICE ~54
MTR: Reach=0.30 Impact=8 Confidence=0.5 Effort=4 => RICE ~30
```

note: pb helps medium-traffic SSO customers; mtr helps finserv/low-latency profiles

Maria G: pb reach looks off to me. telemetry shows ~25% of requests are actually prefix-cacheable. should be 0.25 not 0.45

Anne W: good catch. updated calc: PB Reach=0.25 -> RICE ~30 (Impact*Reach*Confidence/Effort)

Liam O: sequencing context: PB needs KV-cache infra + canary plumbing + perf monitoring. MTR needs a routing policy layer and compatible model variants. PB has higher infra lift but smaller product surface area. my leaning: small PB MVP in Q3, MTR in Q4.

Derek C: customers who asked for MTR (esp. fintech) said they'd accept higher cost for lower p99. we could mitigate short-term by docs on pinning model variants in Dedicated as a config knob. reduces immediate urgency.

Maria G: proposed launch gates for PB MVP:
- gate 1: perf bench: p99 regression <= +10ms
- gate 2: quality smoke: top 5 prompts, no >5% degradation
- gate 3: canary: 2% traffic for 48h w/ rollback playbook
- gate 4: billing opt-in flag / customer consent

Anne W: add a success metric: per-token unit cost down 15% for covered traffic; if not hit we rollback and re-eval

Liam O: proposal: scope PB MVP to hosted + dedicated only (exclude private/KMS/airgap for Q3). private adds too many compliance edge cases

Anne W: agreed. scope to hosted/dedicated for MVP. we will document private constraints for later

Derek C: i'll run a quick sensitivity analysis across Reach in [0.2,0.4] and post results by 1700. will include alternate RICE ranking and a small table of breakpoints

Anne W: please flag any objections to PB-first ASAP. assuming silence i'll mark PB MVP as prioritized for Q3 and update the roadmap PR

SamBot: deploy-bot: branch roadmap/priorities updated by anne-w: commit "pb-mvp-prio"

Maria G: no objections from my side :thumbsup:

Derek C: none here

Liam O: ok. i'll create sequencing tasks on eng board and assign KV-cache owner.

Anne W: final state: PB MVP prioritized for Q3, RICE numbers updated, launch gates agreed, MVP scope=hosted+dedi. thanks all.
